citations.claim: total energy at step 20 is near initial, before collision
total energy jumps ~217J at first violating step 21 during body-body contact
body 0 gains large speed at collision step 21

counterfactual.change: reduced body 1 initial vx from -10.689 to -5.0 so bodies do not collide within 21 steps; energy stays bounded, proving collision at large dt caused the gain

explanation: At dt=0.026 with 10 substeps, light fast body 1 strikes heavy body 0 obliquely at step 21 (touching_pairs gap 0.036). Energy jumps from ~874J to ~1091J (+24.7%), exceeding 10%+5J tolerance, even with e=0. Small-dt (0.001) run of same setup shows no gain. Likely cause: impulse + positional correction at large effective displacement per substep injects energy (overlap resolved by pushing apart along line of centers adds separation velocity beyond restitution, or sequential impulse ordering error).
vision_note: A small blue dot approaches a large blue circle from the left and makes grazing contact on its lower-left side around steps 20 to 21. The small body then slides slightly underneath the large one with no visible explosion, tunneling, walls or color highlighting.
